sourcedFrom: Springfield Armory SAINT Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) (undated on cover)
cleanIntro: Springfield states the field strip is the same across all SAINT models regardless of caliber — with one exception, the SAINT PDW, which needs a different technique and is not this listing.

steps.title: Eye protection first
steps.action: Put proper eye protection on before cleaning.
steps.prose: Springfield makes this step 1 of the field strip, ahead of handling the rifle at all.
steps.quote: Always use proper eye protection when cleaning firearms.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory SAINT Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Stripping & Cleaning, step 1, p.24
steps.warn: ALWAYS REMEMBER THE FIREARM IS ABLE TO FIRE WITH OR WITHOUT THE MAGAZINE IN PLACE.

steps.title: Muzzle safe, magazine out, unload
steps.action: Point the rifle in a safe direction with your finger off the trigger, then remove the magazine and unload it.
steps.prose: A SAINT will fire with or without a magazine in place.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory SAINT Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Stripping & Cleaning, step 3, p.24

steps.title: Close the bolt, safety to SAFE
steps.action: Fully retract the charging handle then release it to close the bolt completely, and rotate the safety selector to "SAFE".
steps.prose: Selector to SAFE before the receivers open.
steps.quote: Fully retract the charging handle then release to completely close the bolt.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory SAINT Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Stripping & Cleaning, step 4, p.24

steps.title: Depress the takedown pin
steps.action: Depress the takedown pin, located just above and to the rear of the safety selector on the left side of the receiver.
steps.prose: Left side to start, and the location is specific — above and behind the selector.
steps.quote: Depress the take down pin located just above and to the rear of the safety/selector on the left side of the receiver.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory SAINT Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Stripping & Cleaning, step 6, p.24

steps.title: Pull it to the mechanical stop
steps.action: From the right side of the receiver, pull the pin outward until the mechanical stop prevents further movement.
steps.prose: It is captive — it stops on its own rather than coming free.
steps.quote: From the right side of the receiver pull the pin outward until the mechanical stop prevents further movement.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory SAINT Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Stripping & Cleaning, step 7, p.24

steps.title: Hinge it open to 45 degrees
steps.action: Let the lower receiver pivot downward away from the upper, and rotate the rifle until upper and lower are both at a 45 degree angle.
steps.prose: The 45 degree angle is what gives the charging handle room in the next step.
steps.quote: Rotate the rifle/pistol until the upper and lower receivers are both at a 45 degree angle
steps.cite: Springfield Armory SAINT Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Stripping & Cleaning, step 8, p.24

steps.title: Charging handle back an inch, carrier out
steps.action: Unlatch and retract the charging handle about 1 inch to expose the rear of the bolt carrier, then grasp the carrier and pull it rearward until it is free of the receiver.
steps.prose: About an inch — enough to expose the carrier, not enough to strand it.
steps.quote: Unlatch and retract the charging handle approximately 1" exposing the rear of the bolt
steps.cite: Springfield Armory SAINT Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Stripping & Cleaning, step 9, p.24

deepAbsentReason: The SAINT manual ends its field strip at "The rifle is now field stripped for routine cleaning." Its later sections cover maintenance points, the Accu-Tite system and the adjustable gas block rather than a deeper disassembly, so this listing has NO deep clean.

cleaning.name: BORE & CHAMBER
tasks: Solvent-wet patch from the chamber end, correctly sized brush, then dry patches until clean
Clean the chamber and locking lug recesses

cleaning.name: BOLT CARRIER GROUP
tasks: Scrub the bolt face and the extractor recess
Clean carbon off the bolt tail and inside the carrier
Light oil on the carrier rails and cam pin

cleaning.name: UPPER & LOWER
tasks: Wipe the upper interior and the charging handle channel
Brush the lower, especially around the trigger group
Keep oil light and out of the fire control

reassembly: Return the bolt carrier group and charging handle to the upper receiver.
Close the receivers and push the takedown pin back through.
Function-check with the magazine out and the chamber confirmed empty.
fncheck: With the magazine out and the chamber confirmed empty: selector to SAFE blocks the trigger, and the bolt carrier runs freely.
